prose.1: What wait I for but Thee? My hope is in Thy Name; From all my sins deliver me, Nor put my soul to shame.
prose.2: I suffered silently, Because Thy will is best; Remove Thy heavy stroke from me, For I am sore distressed.
prose.3: When sin Thou dost repay And chasten and restrain, Man's beauty quickly fades away; Yea, human life is vain.
prose.4: O Lord, regard my fears, And answer my request; Turn not in silence from my tears, But give the mourner rest.
prose.5: I am a stranger here, Dependent on Thy grace, A pilgrim, as my fathers were, With no abiding place.
prose.6: O spare me and restore My failing strength, I pray; Ere I go hence and be no more, The hand of judgment stay.

prose.1: My end, Lord, make me know, My days, how soon they fail; And to my thoughtful spirit show How weak I am and frail.
prose.2: To Thy eternal thought My days are but a span; To Thee my years appear as nought, A breath at best is man.
prose.3: O Lord, regard my fears, And answer my request; Turn not in silence from my tears, But give the mourner rest.
prose.4: I am a stranger here, Dependent on Thy grace, A pilgrim, as my fathers were, With no abiding place.

prose.1: I waited for the Lord my God, Yea, patiently drew near, And He at length inclined to me, My pleading cry to hear.
prose.2: He took me from destruction's pit, From out the miry clay; He set my feet upon a rock, And steadfast made my way.
prose.3: A new and joyful song of praise My thankful heart He taught, A song of glory to our God For all that He has wrought.
prose.4: And many who behold how good The Lord has been to me Shall learn to fear, and in His Name Their trust henceforth shall be.
prose.5: O truly blessed is the man That on the Lord relies, Respecting not the proud, nor such As turn aside to lies.
prose.6: O Lord my God, how manifold The works which Thou hast wrought, Ofttimes Thou hast bestowed on us Thy care and gracious thought.
prose.7: Thy works and thoughts most wonderful, If I of them would speak, Cannot be numbered, and in vain To set them forth I seek.
